psychology: Von Restorff (by subtraction) — draining all colour makes the amber timer + green head-tracking dot pre-attentively salient; the one different thing is remembered
Natural mapping (Norman) — the polar stage maps UI position directly to 3D audio position; drag-where-you-hear
Aesthetic-Usability effect — the immersive dark canvas + wireframe head buys a strong first-impression halo for an ambient tool
Hick's Law — 41 sounds scoped by category chips reduces choice at the browse decision point
Jakob's Law (mild violation) — carded rows + chip filters import iPhone idioms onto the Mac; familiar to iOS users but slightly off macOS convention
Fitts's Law — large emitter-node targets on the canvas and whole-row targets in the list; generous
